DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の用紙で、まだ書かれていない欄がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: There are still some blank sections on your change-of-address form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕上げて提出する前に、職場から戻るよう連絡が来ました。今日はここで申請を進めず、出直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事呼出のため未完成住所変更を提出せず出直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Before I could finish and submit it, my workplace contacted me to return. I would like to stop the application here today and come back another time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have been called back to work and would like to return another time without submitting the unfinished address-change form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ登録の処理は始めていません。お預かりしていた本人確認の資料は、お返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not started processing the registration yet. I will return the identification document we were holding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用紙も持ち帰ってよいですか。次に来る時まで手元で続きを書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 次回来店まで記入できるよう未提出の用紙の持帰りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I take the form home too? I would like to keep it and continue filling it in before my next visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may take the unsubmitted form home so you can fill it in before your next visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この未提出の用紙もお返しします。次回、記入を終えて資料と一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will return this unsubmitted form too. Next time, please finish filling it in and bring it with your document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 用紙を受け取りました。今日渡した資料は本人確認の物一枚だけなので、それも返っているか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出用紙受領と本人資料一枚の返却を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the form. The only document I handed over today was one identification document, so I will check that it has also been returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have received the unsubmitted form and want to check the return of your one identification document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。変更の受付が済んだという控えではありませんので、ご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your document. Please note that this is not a receipt confirming that the address change has been accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人確認の資料を受け取りました。今日は住所変更の受付前で終えたと、自分の予定に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料を受領し変更受付前の終了と記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received the identification document. I will write in my schedule that I ended today's visit before the address-change application was accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Receive your document and record that the visit ended before acceptance of the address change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次回お越しの際、記入した新しい住所と資料を確認します。お戻りの日時は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: On your next visit, we will check the new address you have written and your document. Have you decided when you will return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次に来る日はまだ決まっていません。家で続きを書いて、この資料と一緒に持って来ます。勤務先にも手続きは次回だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回来店日未定で自宅記入と資料持参を予定し勤務先へ次回手続きと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not decided on my next visit yet. I will continue filling it in at home and bring it with this document. I will also tell my workplace that the procedure will be done next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your next visit is undecided, that you plan to fill the form in at home and bring the document, and that you will tell your workplace the procedure will be next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未提出の用紙と資料をお返ししました。それでは、次回のお手続きにお越しください。お仕事へお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have returned the unsubmitted form and your document. Please come back to complete the procedure next time. Take care on your way to work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麺つゆをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for noodle dipping or soup sauce?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この小さい瓶なら、麺にそのままかけられると思いました。でも濃縮とあります。使い方の表示はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 麺つゆ濃縮表示に気づき使用法の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I could pour this small bottle straight onto noodles. But it says concentrated. Where are the instructions for using it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice the concentrated label on the noodle sauce and ask where the instructions are. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 裏にございます。この商品には、かけつゆの場合、つゆ一に水三と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are on the back. This product says one part sauce to three parts water when making broth to pour over noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: つゆ一に水三ですね。家には目盛り付きのカップがあります。同じカップで量ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一対三の表示を読み目盛り付きカップでの量り方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One part sauce to three parts water, right? I have a measuring cup at home. Should I measure both with the same cup?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the one-to-three ratio and check how to measure it with a graduated cup. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、同じ単位でつゆ一に対して水三を量る表示です。薄めず使う別の商品もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it means measure one part sauce to three parts water using the same unit. There are also other products used without dilution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で薄められそうです。この瓶で作れる量も、裏の表示を見て選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄める用具があり作れる量も表示から確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think I can dilute it myself. I would also like to check the label on the back to see how much this bottle makes before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have equipment for diluting it and also want to check the label for the quantity it makes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際に使う量は、薄め方も合わせてお考えください。どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consider the dilution method as well when deciding the amount you will actually use. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この濃縮の瓶にします。今日は二人分だけ使うので、必要な分をカップで量り、表示を見て水を足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 濃縮を選び二人分だけ表示に従い量ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take this concentrated bottle. I will only use enough for two people today, so I will measure the amount needed with the cup and add water according to the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the concentrate and decide to measure only enough for two people according to the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをかごへお入れください。保存についても商品の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put this in your basket. Also check the product label for storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存の欄も読みました。濃縮という字と使い方を確認して選べました。この一本を買います。教えていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存表示も読み一本を購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the storage section too. I was able to choose after checking the word concentrated and the instructions. I will buy this one bottle. Thank you for explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have also read the storage label and will buy one bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、レジへどうぞ。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Please go to the checkout, then. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示板の利用について、ご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: How may I help with using the noticeboard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人と日本語で話しながら歩く会を作りました。このチラシを公園の掲示板へ貼ってもよいか、先に聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自主日本語歩く会チラシの事前掲示許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have started a group for walking while speaking Japanese with people in the neighborhood. I came to ask first whether we may put this flyer on the park noticeboard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in advance for permission to post a flyer for an independently organized Japanese walking group. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示は申込みを確認してからです。今お持ちのチラシを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the application before it can be posted. May I see the flyer you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。日時と集合場所を書きましたが、市が主催する会ではありません。私たちの小さな会として掲示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時集合場所を示し市主催ではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I wrote the date, time and meeting place, but the city is not organizing it. We would like to post it as our own small group.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the date, time and meeting place, and make clear that the city is not the organizer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 主催者の名前と連絡先も、申込用紙で確認します。チラシには、市の行事と誤解されない表現が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will also check the organizer's name and contact details on the application form. The flyer needs wording that will not be mistaken for a city event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市の名前を主催欄へ入れず、私たちの会の名前にします。申込用紙の連絡先は私の番号でよいか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自主会主催名にし主催連絡先記入を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put our group's name in the organizer section instead of the city's name. I would like to check whether I can put my own number as the contact on the application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the independent group's name as the organizer and check the organizer contact entry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 主催者へ連絡できる番号をご記入ください。掲示期間の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter a number where the organizer can be reached. Do you have a preferred posting period?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会は再来週の日曜です。始まる前の日までを希望します。終わった後も募集が続くような貼り方にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開催前日までの掲示期間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The group meets on Sunday the week after next. I would like it posted until the day before it starts. I will not leave it up in a way that looks as if recruitment continues after the event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a posting period ending on the day before the event. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容と期間を担当が確認します。今はまだ掲示しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the content and period. Please do not post it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙とチラシを出します。掲示できるか分かったら、貼る場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙とチラシを提出し承認後の掲示場所も案内してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit the form and flyer. Once you know whether it may be posted, please also tell me where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the form and flyer, and ask for guidance on the posting location after approval. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込みをお預かりします。それでは、担当からの案内をお待ちください。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take your application. Please wait for guidance from the person in charge. Thank you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの読取りで、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the card reader?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二枚入ったケースをかざしたら、やり直しの表示が出ました。二枚とも使えなくなったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二カードケース読取エラーで故障か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I held up the case with two cards inside, a message told me to try again. Have both cards stopped working?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a reading error with a two-card case means the cards are faulty. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、お使いになる一枚をケースから出してください。表示だけで故障とは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please take the one card you will use out of the case. The message alone does not establish that it is faulty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い方が今日使うカードです。もう一枚は別の場所で使う物なので、財布へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日用青カード一枚を出し他を財布へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The blue one is the card I will use today. The other is for a different place, so I will put it back in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Take out only today's blue card and return the other to your wallet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その一枚について、読取りの状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the reading status of that one card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ケースから出さなくても読めると思い、二枚が重なっていることに気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースに二枚重なっていることに気づかずかざした経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I thought it could be read without taking it out of the case and did not realize the two cards were overlapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you held up the case without realizing two cards were overlapping inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は、このカードで入場の処理が済んでいない状態です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: At present, entry has not yet been processed with this card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ入場の処理が済んでいないのですね。確認が終わるまで、こちらでカードを持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未入場と確認し処理まで改札外待機する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So entry has not been processed yet. I will wait here holding the card until the check is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have not entered and wait outside the ticket gates until processing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。こちらの一枚でお進みいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have checked it. You may proceed using this one card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。青い一枚だけを手に持ち、表示を確認してから通ります。使い終えてからケースへ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚保持で表示確認後通過し使用後収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will hold only the blue card, check the display, and then go through. I will put it back in the case after using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold one card, go through after checking the display, and store it after use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらからお進みください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go through here, then. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市民農園のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the community allotments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。野菜を育ててみたいですが、夏に三週間の出張があります。家族に水やりを頼めるか、申込み前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市民農園希望と三週出張中の家族水やりを申込前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to try growing vegetables, but I have a three-week business trip in summer. Before applying, I would like to ask whether I can have a family member water them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before applying for a community allotment, explain your interest and ask about family watering during a three-week business trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用する方と、世話をする方について、担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with the person in charge about the user and the person tending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申し込むのは私で、弟には留守の三週間だけ水やりを頼む予定です。本人以外が手伝えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人申込みと弟の一時世話を区画譲渡と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will be the applicant, and I plan to ask my younger brother to water only during the three weeks I am away. I want to check whether someone other than the user may help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own application and your younger brother's temporary care from transferring the plot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出張の時期と期間もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell them when the business trip is and how long it lasts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八月の初めから三週間です。まだ何を植えるか決めていません。留守の間も育て続けられる計画にできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 八月初め三週で作物未決の継続計画を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is for three weeks from the beginning of August. I have not decided what to plant yet. I want to ask whether I can make a plan that lets me keep growing things while I am away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain a plan for continued cultivation during three weeks from early August, with crops undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用の条件や、講習の案内を担当からお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the person in charge about the usage conditions and training information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 利用者以外が入って世話をする時の条件を、担当の方に確かめます。弟へ頼むのは、その説明を聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弟へ入場を約束せず非利用者世話条件を先に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check with the person in charge about the conditions when someone other than the user enters to tend the plot. I will ask my brother after hearing that explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for care by a non-user first, without promising your younger brother that he may enter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 募集の時期なども、この案内の担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask the contact on this information sheet about application periods and other matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を持ち帰ります。自分の申込みと出張中の世話を分けて質問し、続けられる方法が分かってから応募を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 募集案内を持帰り申込み世話条件の確認後応募を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the information home. I will ask separately about my application and care while I am away, and consider applying after finding out how I can continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the application information home and consider applying after checking the application and care conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、農園の担当へお問い合わせください。ご準備にお役立てください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please contact the allotment staff, then. I hope the information helps you prepare. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察までにお伝えになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell us before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は気分が悪くて朝ご飯を食べられませんでした。いつもの薬についても確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食不能の不調と常用薬相談を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I felt unwell today and could not eat breakfast. I would also like to check about my regular medication.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report feeling too unwell to eat breakfast and wanting advice about regular medication. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬は、今朝もうお飲みになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already taken your medicine this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ飲んでいません。今朝は食事が取れていないので、この状態でどうすればよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝未服薬で食事状況も伝える必要を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not taken it yet. I have not been able to eat this morning, so I want to check what I should do in this situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not taken this morning's medicine and need to explain your food intake too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事の状況と、お薬の内容を診療担当へ伝えます。薬の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell the clinical staff about your food intake and your medication. Do you know the medicine's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この袋を持ってきました。昨日の夜は飲みましたが、今朝の分は袋に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬袋を示し昨夜服薬と今朝残りを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought this medication bag. I took it last night, but this morning's dose is still in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the medication bag and distinguish last night's dose taken from this morning's dose remaining. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からないまま量を変えず、担当の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not change the dose without understanding what to do; please wait for the staff's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当の方の説明を待ちます。朝の分の袋もありますので、いつ飲むかも一緒に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未服薬の朝分を示し飲む時期も担当へ確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait for the staff's explanation. I also have the bag for the morning dose, so could you ask them to check when I should take it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the untaken morning dose and ask the staff to check when you should take it as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 水分は取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you been able to drink fluids?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水は少し飲めました。朝食は取れず、今朝の薬もまだという二つを、袋を見せて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量飲水と朝食不能未服薬をまとめ担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was able to drink a little water. I will show the bag and explain both that I could not eat breakfast and that I have not taken this morning's medicine yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the staff together that you drank a little water, could not eat breakfast, and have not taken your medication. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当にお伝えします。こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will let the staff know, then. Please wait here. Take care, and I hope you feel better.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの紙についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about this paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車の登録の控えをポケットに入れたまま洗濯しました。文字が薄くなり、番号を読めなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録控えを洗濯し文字番号が薄く読めないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I washed my clothes with the bicycle registration receipt still in my pocket. The print has faded, and I can no longer read the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you washed the registration receipt and the faded text and number are unreadable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の状態の紙をお見せください。自転車は、お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the paper in its current condition. Do you have the bicycle with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自転車は家にあります。車体に貼ったシールは、まだ読むことができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自転車は自宅にあり車体の登録シールが読めると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bicycle is at home. The sticker attached to the frame is still readable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bicycle is at home and the registration sticker on its frame can still be read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自転車に付いている表示についても、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell the person in charge about the markings attached to the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そのシールの番号と、家にある購入時の資料で確認できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体シールと購入資料による確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know whether it can be checked using the number on that sticker and the purchase documents at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to verify it with the frame sticker and purchase documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認の方法を担当がご案内します。ほかに購入時の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the verification method. Do you have any other purchase documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入した店の控えは家にあります。今はこの濡れて乾いた紙だけなので、必要なら別の資料も用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入控えは家で必要資料を案内後用意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The receipt from the shop where I bought it is at home. Right now, I only have this paper that got wet and then dried, so I will prepare other documents if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the purchase receipt is at home and you will prepare the required documents after receiving guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読めない紙も捨てずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep and bring the unreadable paper too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この紙も残しておきます。今読めるのは、店の名前のこの部分だけです。次にどの資料を持って来ればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 損傷した紙の読める店名を示し次に必要な資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep this paper too. The only part I can read now is this part of the shop's name. Please tell me which documents to bring next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the readable shop name on the damaged paper and ask which documents are needed next. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へどうぞ。紙をそのままお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the person in charge, then. Bring the paper as it is. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどのお手紙について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the letter from earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かばんに残った封筒を見て気づきました。先ほど出した友人宛ての白い封筒に、会社へ出す手紙を入れたかもしれません。確認をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送直後二通の中身を宛先違いに入れた疑いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed when I saw the envelope left in my bag. I may have put the letter for my company in the white envelope addressed to my friend that I just sent. I would like you to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Just after sending, explain your suspicion that the contents of two letters were put in envelopes with the wrong addressees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの封筒をお出しになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い封筒一通です。家から二通持ってきて、もう一通はまだかばんにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白一通発送と一通手元を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One white envelope. I brought two from home, and the other is still in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you sent one white envelope and still have one with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだお手元にある方を、ご自身で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check the one you still have yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらを開けて見ます。会社への手紙が入っているはずでしたが、友人への便箋でした。入れ違えたと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人手元便確認で友人便箋入りの逆入れを発見する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will open this one and look. It should have contained the letter to my company, but it was the letter written to my friend. Now I know I switched them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the letter still with you and discover that it contains the letter to your friend, confirming the switch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お出しになった分の扱いは、担当が確認します。控えをお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check how to handle the one you sent. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えです。受付の時刻も書いてあります。確認のために、ほかに必要な情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付時刻のある控えを提示し追加で必要な情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the receipt. It also shows the acceptance time. Is there any other information needed for the check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the receipt with the acceptance time and ask what additional information is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず、この控えとお出しになった封筒の特徴を担当へ伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, I will tell the person in charge about this receipt and the features of the envelope you sent. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。友人宛てに会社の手紙を入れたこと、白い封筒一通を先ほど出したことを、担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誤封入の対象と白一通発送時点を伝え担当確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. I will explain to the person in charge that I put the company letter in the envelope addressed to my friend and that I sent one white envelope just now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain what was wrongly enclosed and when you sent the one white envelope, and wait for the staff to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当に確認します。控えをお持ちになってお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the person in charge, then. Please keep your receipt with you and wait. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は、現金のお引出しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族へ渡す現金が必要です。口座には五万円ありますが、今日は三万円だけ引き出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五万円残高から家族用三万円のみの引出しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I need cash to give to my family. There is 50,000 yen in the account, but I only want to withdraw 30,000 yen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to withdraw only 30,000 yen for your family from a 50,000-yen balance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望のお引出し額は三万円ですね。こちらの用紙へご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like to withdraw 30,000 yen, correct? Please fill in this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の欄に三万円ですね。残高の五万円と間違えないよう、先に確認したかったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高でなく希望現金額を金額欄へ書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So 30,000 yen in the amount field. I wanted to check first so I would not confuse it with the balance of 50,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will write the cash amount requested in the amount field, rather than the balance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。お受け取りになる三万円をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please write the 30,000 yen you will receive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三万円と書けました。手元のメモには二万円とも書いてあるので、渡す時に紛らわしくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用紙三万円記入後に二万円の別メモが紛らわしいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written 30,000 yen. My note also says 20,000 yen, so it could be confusing when I hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After entering 30,000 yen on the form, say that a separate note of 20,000 yen is confusing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二万円は、何の金額でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: What does the 20,000 yen refer to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引き出した後に口座へ残したい額です。受け取る現金の額ではないので、メモに「残す分」と書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二万円は引出後の口座残額と説明してメモへ用途を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the amount I want to leave in the account after withdrawing. It is not the cash amount I will receive, so I will add 'amount to leave' to my note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that 20,000 yen is the balance to remain after the withdrawal and label its purpose on the note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入内容とお手続きを確認してから、現金のご案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the entries and the procedure before advising you about the cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日受け取るのは三万円で、残りの二万円は口座に置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三万円引出しと二万円口座維持を最終確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will receive 30,000 yen today and leave the remaining 20,000 yen in the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finally confirm withdrawing 30,000 yen and keeping 20,000 yen in the account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、用紙を確認いたします。お待ちいただきありがとうございます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the form, then. Thank you for waiting. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご試食はいかがでしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: おいしかったです。この小さい容器は、空になったら商品が並んでいる台へ戻すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食済容器を販売台へ戻すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was delicious. Once this small container is empty, should I return it to the display table where the products are?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to return the used sample container to the sales table. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使用した容器は、横の回収箱へお願いします。販売品の棚には置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please put used containers in the collection box at the side. Do not put them on the shelves with the items for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここが回収箱ですね。未使用の容器がある所とも、分けて使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 回収箱を確認し未使用容器置場と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the collection box, right? I will also keep it separate from the place for unused containers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the collection box and distinguish it from the place for unused containers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。お買い求めになる場合は、こちらの商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. If you would like to buy it, this is the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この袋の商品ですね。気に入ったので、一つ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試食した商品の販売袋を一つ購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The product in this bag, right? I liked it, so I would like to buy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to buy one retail bag of the sampled product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容量や材料は、袋の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the label on the bag for the net weight and ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内容量は百グラムですね。材料の表示も確認してから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋の百グラムの内容量と材料表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The net weight is 100 grams, right? I will check the ingredients label too before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the bag's 100-gram net weight and ingredients label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご不明な表示は、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask if anything on the label is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空の容器は回収箱へ入れました。袋の表示も確認できたので、商品一袋だけをかごへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器回収と表示確認後商品だけかごへ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the empty container in the collection box. I have also checked the bag's label, so I will put just one bag of the product in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After disposing of the container in the collection box and checking the label, put only the product in the basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ご試食ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the checkout, then. Thank you for trying the sample. Excuse me.
